$comment: Values verify-templates uses to fill the language-switch flow: the testIDs of a Tasks app's home screen, add-task button, task title field, save button, settings entry, language row, the Arabic option and the restart confirmation, the id pattern of a task row (a regular expression: a row's testID ends in its task id), plus the title of the task the flow creates and expects back after the restart. An app puts its own testIDs here.
